evidence:
Seed is empty: task/environment/assets/seed_data.json is {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. ..."}; server.js only creates tables (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snippets ..., lines 147-168) and inserts no rows, so the reference library starts empty. Reference initial UI state (solution/app/src/app.tsx lines 22-33): code '', filename 'snippet.js', title 'Untitled', snippets [], history [], entries [] (empty console), status 'Ready'; the only load effect is refresh() of the list (lines 131-134), nothing is auto-opened or auto-run. I enumerated every value the 51 criteria tell the judge to create. Exactly one is a fixed literal: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml line 101 (cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic) 'Type the five characters MULTI'. A case-sensitive grep for MULTI across the whole frozen task (excluding package-lock.json) hits only that criterion line: it is absent from the seed, solution/app/src, public bundle, index.html, runner.html, server.js and solve.sh. The criterion also proves the mutation by count ('must appear exactly once at each caret and nowhere else', fifteen characters undone/redone) on a judge-authored fixture, so it cannot be met by pre-existing text. Every other probe is judge-chosen and described as 'unique'/'distinctive' (titles, sources, console/preview markers, hostile marker, localStorage key/value, payload markers built from two halves, two three-digit integers), and the prompts require the judge to verify its own fixture first (app_context.md: 'Read the current source from the rendered editor lines and check it equals your fixture before acting on it'; functional prompt: 'You may choose the exact fixture text for each criterion. Check that the editor holds it before acting'). Negative/absence observables carry their own baseline or positive control so an initial state cannot satisfy them: cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft ('Wait ten seconds and confirm that A shows no notice about a newer revision yet: this is the baseline'), cw_unsaved_marker (no indication while draft equals saved revision, then appears after an edit), cw_run_starts_fresh_document (first run must report the property as defined), cw_preview_isolation (set and read back the localStorage entry; app's own keys are cw-width-v2/cw-height-v2 only). The only fixed strings in the reference's reachable state are 'Untitled', 'snippet.js', status 'Ready', and the starter draft inserted by New (app.tsx line 99: 'document.body.innerHTML = "

Hello, Colderwater

"; console.log("Ready to explore.");'); no criterion names any of these words as a probe, and criteria that use New (cw_save_reload_restart, cw_undo_redo_availability) require an 'exact unique title and filename' plus a typed distinctive marker, so the starter text cannot stand in for the judge's value. app_context.md also warns 'the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library', and records are 'identified by the server, not by title'. Scripted golden on these bytes (hashes verified): editor.json cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic true with source 'redMULTI one greenMULTI two blueMULTI three' asserted in tests/editor.cjs:155, i.e. MULTI appears only where typed. Limits: this is a source/static determination plus scripted golden; the private check-probe-not-in-seed.py was not executed (applied by hand), and no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so which concrete 'distinctive' words the judge model picks is unmeasured. Tried weak app: a static page with pre-rendered text cannot pass any probe because no criterion fixes a value other than MULTI, and MULTI must appear exactly three times after three specific carets on a judge-authored fixture and vanish on one Undo. Tried conforming alternative: an app that opens with a non-empty starter draft or with previously saved records is not failed by this row's concern, because criteria use scratch drafts and unique titles.
run_verdict: PARTIAL: scripted golden on these bytes confirms the one literal probe (MULTI) is absent before typing and present exactly at the three carets after; no configured judge run on these bytes, so judge-chosen probe values are NOT EXERCISED.
